{{Top|leg}}
The '''omniscience unit''' was a sensor array module manufactured with unique technology. It greatly increased the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] awareness of activity in the immediate environment.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only [[G0-T0]] is able to equip this item.
